customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be of high quality, with all features working smoothly and providing peace of mind through its secure multi-bolt system. They appreciate its versatility with multiple access methods, including fingerprint, face ID, and password options, and find it easy to use, particularly through fingerprint recognition. Customers consider it good value for money, adding to their home's appeal, and one customer mentions it's especially convenient for elderly and children.

reviews.title: x95 Golens product and service experience.
reviews.body: I bought an x95 model Golens smart door lock after a lot of research online and physically at outlets. I could find only this model that actually suited my door specs and the carpentry required for replacing the existing conventional lock. Product delivery: Well packed, neatly categorised and highly safe boxing. No surprises of missing components or parts. No complaints in product finishes and build quality. reviews.author: Rahul
reviews.title: Worst experience with Golens
reviews.body: Absolutely terrible experience with golens x95. I bought this lock on 7/6/25 and got it installed on 31 july 26 from Golens for an additional charge of 1500 rupees; as there was construction going on in my house. It worked fine for a few days but when the battery drained and I tried to charge it, i noticed that the battery is faulty and not getting charged. Even after charging it for a whole day it worked only for a few mins. When I contacted customer care then I was told I need to pay additional 2850 for replacement battery. Absolutely ridiculous and shady brand. Won't recommend to anyone.
